page_title: AUX 0-3 MON | Auxerre v Monaco 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Abdelatif Kherradji is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90+10' Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
90+9' Adi Hutter is forced to make a change. Lamine Camara is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Wilfried Singo (Monaco).

90+8' Auxerre are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90+3' The game is interrupted now, Lamine Camara (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' 0 - 3 Goal! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:3.

89' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
89' The referee allows time for a substitution. Vanderson will be replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
88' The ball is cleared after Caio Henrique (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
86' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
85' The substitution is prepared. Assane Diousse (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lassine Sinayoko.
85' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Aristide Zossou (Auxerre) replaces Paul Joly.
85' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
84' The game is interrupted as George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is flagged offside.
83' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) replaces Maghnes Akliouche.
82' Donovan Leon displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Folarin Balogun (Monaco) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
80' Total attempts – 8:13.
78' Vanderson (Monaco) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
77' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is able to continue to play.
74' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
71' That's the end of the game for Elisha Owusu, who is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
71' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Danois (Auxerre) replacing Gaetan Perrin.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Raveloson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
70' Auxerre are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
69' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
67' Caio Henrique (Monaco) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

66' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
64' The manager makes a subsitution with George Ilenikhena (Monaco) coming on for Breel Embolo.
64' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir will be replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is replacing Aleksandr Golovin.
63' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) steps up to send the ball in.

62' Breel Embolo (Monaco) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Donovan Leon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
61' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
60' Lamine Camara (Monaco) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
58' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
58' Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
56' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Breel Embolo (Monaco) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
54' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
53' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Jubal (Auxerre) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Caio Henrique (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' Paul Joly (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45+2' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+1' Jubal (Auxerre) has tested the patience of referee Abdelatif Kherradji and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
41' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
39' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Donovan Leon is alert and denies him.
38' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
36' The Auxerre players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' The ball is cleared after Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
28' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Breel Embolo (Monaco) heads on.
25' 0 - 2 Goal! Denis Zakaria puts a cross into the box and finds Vanderson (Monaco), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
24' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.

24' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Philipp Kohn, who pulls off a comfortable save!
23' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Breel Embolo (Monaco). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
20' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
20' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Abdelatif Kherradji saw the whole situation.
18' Monaco are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Abdelatif Kherradji didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
13' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
11' Lamine Camara (Monaco) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

8' 0 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
8' Lamine Camara (Monaco) will deliver the corner kick.
7' Breel Embolo (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Monaco keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
5' Paul Joly (Auxerre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
4' The game is interrupted. Caio Henrique (Monaco) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' Paul Joly (Auxerre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Auxerre will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Abdelatif Kherradji.
